content:
**The Slasher: Secrets to the Grave** is a main quest in *Fallout 76*. It will be implemented in the upcoming fall 2026 update. It is the second of four quests associated with The Slasher, a cycle of limited-time seasonal content.

This quest is only available for a limited-time, when The Slasher seasonal content is active. It is associated with "Phase 2" of the seasonal content, as tracked by The Slasher overarching side quest.

Secrets to the Grave is started automatically once it is enabled as part of Phase 2 of The Slasher, unless the previous quest, Masked Truth, has not yet been completed. Masked Truth must be completed in order to advance to Secrets to the Grave, regardless of The Slasher's phase-based progression. The first objective of the quest is to complete an activity or public event, which will dispense a Pint-Sized Phantoms' map as part of its rewards. Reading the map starts the repeatable quest Disturbed Grave; the map is also removed from the player's inventory once viewing it is exited.

Secrets to the Grave prompts the player to complete Disturbed Grave. The latter quest will point the player to a random location on the map where they must find a bloodied grave. A shovel must be equipped in order to interact with the grave, though most of the disturbed grave locations appear to have a shovel placed next to them, for ease of access. Interact with the grave while holding the shovel. This reveals a ritual pile beneath the dirt. Interacting with the pile dispenses a number of random rewards. During Secrets to the Grave, the player will also receive a note: Our mission - part I.

Secrets to the Grave then prompts the player to repeat this process three times, in total digging up four graves by the end. Complete an activity or event, read the map, and complete Repeatable: Disturbed Grave. The notes Our mission - part II, Our mission - part III, and Our mission - part IV will be part of the rewards at each subsequent and respective grave. Reading part IV after unearthing the fourth grave reveals a directive at the end of the document, pointing the reader to Tyler County Fairgrounds.

Traveling to the fairgrounds, there may be hostile Pint-Sized Phantoms. The player will eventually come across a smiling clown toy sitting on a fortune teller machine. A message box appears saying that a holotape was found hidden behind the smiling clown toy. Listen to the holotape Invite me, which contains an ominous message. The quest completes after the holotape finishes playing. Unlike Masked Truth, there are no progressive challenges with unique rewards associated with grave digging, though the player can continue to collect maps from activites/events, and receive rewards from Repeatable: Disturbed Grave. For a list of potential rewards from gravedigging, see here.

Head Hunts and Defend Workshop do not count for the events that drop the Pint-Sized Phantoms' map.
